heading.description: Dialog heading. Only used when `confirm-title` is absent.

message.description: Body text. Only used when `confirm-message` is absent.

confirm-text.description: Label on the confirming button. Defaults to `OK`.

cancel-text.description: Label on the dismissing button. Defaults to `Cancel`.

confirm-title.description: Dialog heading. Read BEFORE `heading`; defaults to `Confirm`.

confirm-message.description: Body text. Read BEFORE `message`; defaults to `Are you sure?`.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
